mockedToolCalls.description: Optional. All tool calls to mock for the duration of the session.

unmatchedToolCallBehavior.description: Required. Beavhior for tool calls that don't match any args patterns in mocked_tool_calls.

displayName.description: Output only. The fetched Meta business page name.

extraToolCallBehavior.description: Optional. Behavior for extra tool calls. Defaults to FAIL.

mimeType.description: Required. The IANA standard MIME type of the source data.

userIntent.description: Inferred user goal or topic for the session (e.g. "Building E-Commerce Support Agent").

speakingRate.description: Optional. The speaking rate/speed in the range [0.25, 2.0]. 1.0 is the normal native speed supported by the specific voice. 2.0 is twice as fast, and 0.5 is half as fast. Values outside of the range [0.25, 2.0] will return an error.

voice.description: Optional. The name of the voice. If not set, the service will choose a voice based on the other parameters such as language_code. model.description: Optional. The model used to synthesize audio. Currently supported values: - "gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview" If empty, Chirp3-HD is used.

instruction.description: Optional. The instruction used to synthesize speech when using a generative model.

endTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the conversation was completed.

startTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the conversation was created.

name.description: Identifier. The unique identifier of the conversation. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/conversations/{conversation}`

turns.description: Required. The turns in the conversation.

inputTypes.description: Output only. The input types of the conversation.

languageCode.description: Output only. The language code of the conversation.

variables.description: Optional. The variables that are available for the tool execution.

context.description: Optional. The [ToolCallContext](https://docs.cloud.google.com/customer-engagement-ai/conversational-agents/ps/tool/python#environment for details) to be passed to the Python tool.

duration.description: Output only. The duration of the span.

childSpans.description: Output only. The child spans that are nested under this span.

name.description: Output only. The name of the span.

enableCloudLogging.description: Optional. Whether to enable Cloud Logging for the sessions.
